expectations.text: Applies the same criteria set and approval decision to the paid slot as to any unpaid satellite
expectations.evidence: Element 2 lists the criteria and the reply imposes the code of conduct, sponsor check and windows.

expectations.text: Recommends a licensed co-branding grant for this case rather than the default non-affiliation wording
expectations.evidence: 'Naming rule: licensed co-branding, with the disclaimer sentence kept anyway.'

expectations.text: Gives the reason: the organizer wants this event read as connected, which is what breaks the usual case against granting a licence
expectations.evidence: 'You want this event read as connected to yours, and you hold the marks'.

expectations.text: Names Cobalt Registry as the grantee of the licence
expectations.evidence: 'hosted by Cobalt Registry'; reply addressed to Cobalt.

expectations.text: Names the specific marks covered rather than gesturing at "branding" or "our assets"
expectations.evidence: 'The Ferrolink wordmark and our brand colour'.

expectations.text: Binds the grant to one stated purpose
expectations.evidence: 'for this one event only'.

expectations.text: Gives the grant a stated end date, or states that it expires automatically rather than continuing silently into future editions
expectations.evidence: 'ends on [the day after the conference closes]... automatically.'

expectations.text: Requires materials be shown to the organizer before they are printed
expectations.evidence: 'Send us the invite, the RSVP page and any signage before anything is printed or published.'

expectations.text: Keeps a withdrawal right separate from any breach of the criteria, on reputational grounds
expectations.evidence: 'detrimental to our reputation and goodwill. This is separate from any breach.'

expectations.text: States what withdrawal means in practice, including that materials already printed are the sponsor's problem
expectations.evidence: 'Material already printed is yours to deal with.'

expectations.text: Imposes adoption of a code of conduct and a named contact as a condition
expectations.evidence: 'Adopting the Ferrolink Conf Code of Conduct is a condition. Please name a person'.

expectations.text: Deconflicts the Thursday evening slot against the published grid's own protected hours
